consequence.statement: The enhancement lets operators use internal node IPs for NodePort services. The evidence does not say that existing behaviour changes.

assertion.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds the option to use internal node IPs for NodePort services in its Kubernetes providers (k8s/crd, k8s).
